structured_findings.closest_alternative: Wind intensity is the closest competing reading because Freddy was a tropical cyclone, but the late rainfall ledger and flood timing give it less weight for this target.
structured_findings.dominant_signal: Cyclone Freddy's final southern Africa phase is best diagnosed as a late-phase rainfall-runoff signal.
structured_findings.imagery_or_exposure_context: Population, mapped-place, and imagery/change context support analytic importance but should not be treated as direct proof of inundated population, damage, or disruption.
structured_findings.rainfall_test: Late point rainfall is 34.7% of the event point total, and the paired gridded mean is 86.5% of that late point amount.
structured_findings.timing_test: The 2023-03-12 through 2023-03-15 rainfall window aligns with the 2023-03-13 through 2023-03-16 Malawi flood catalog entry.

provenance.notes: All scored values are extracted from local CSX-122 records; no network access is used. WorldPop, OSM, and remote-sensing products are used as package-declared derived context; coordinates, place names, bounding boxes, and georeferencing metadata inside masked products are not used for event-location validity scoring.

criteria.description: Identifies the dominant signal as late-phase rainfall-runoff and assigns high diagnostic class.
criteria.name: Final label and class
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for a flood or heavy-rain answer that misses either the late-phase framing or high class; award up to 1 point for only naming Cyclone Freddy.

criteria.description: Reports 393.6 mm event-total point rainfall, 136.6 mm late-phase point rainfall, 118.113 mm paired gridded rainfall mean, and 701660.812 people as exposure context within the specified tolerances.
criteria.name: Numeric anchors
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for each correct numeric anchor with units or clear field meaning; half credit for values that are directionally correct but outside tolerance.

criteria.description: Computes late-phase share as 0.347 and gridded-mean to late-point-rain ratio as 0.865 with clear denominators.
criteria.name: Derived arithmetic
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for one correct ratio or for correct formulas with minor rounding error.

criteria.description: Connects the February-March Freddy record to the 2023-03-12 through 2023-03-15 rainfall phase and the 2023-03-13 through 2023-03-16 Malawi flood entry.
criteria.name: Timing ledger
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for recognizing late timing or flood timing without clearly linking both date windows.

criteria.description: Treats wind intensity, track persistence, or image-visible landscape change as plausible but less supported for the late-phase target.
criteria.name: Competing readings
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for naming alternatives without explaining why the rainfall ledger carries more weight.

criteria.description: Uses population and imagery/change context without converting it into realized inundation, casualties, building damage, hospital disruption, or road closure.
criteria.name: Imagery and exposure discipline
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mild overstatement that does not drive the answer.

criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON with the label, class, numeric anchors, derived tests, and concise findings.
criteria.name: Structured output
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for mostly correct content with minor formatting or field-name errors.
